A '''Bothan''' [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] civil services employee was brainwashed by agents of [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]] in [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]]. The [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] attempted to blow up a power station on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], but was stopped by his supervisor.
